import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    st=np.sqrt(t)
    g=A/(1+params[3]*A**2)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*st+params[2]*t)*g + (params[4]+params[5]*st+params[6]*t)*np.sqrt(A) + params[7]*A*np.log(A) + params[8]*np.log(A) + params[9]
